answer: Sybil resistance via a reputation token with verifiable provenance. Each identity must hold a minted proof-of-work credential whose issuance is capped, so no farm can cheaply buy many. Attestation weight is a 'willow' that bends only with earned history, not purchases. Every epoch a 'knoll' of random peer-review hills re-checks a sample of credentials, and caught fakes are burned with slashed collateral. A 'fable' mechanism: the token's value is pegged to a redeemable claim a fake cluster can't collectively redeem without exposing itself. Cost: minting work plus collateral at risk.
